cost_basis: Median observed direct expenses, not all-in incremental farm costs

source.publisher: University of Minnesota, Center for Farm Financial Management
source.document: The Economics of Cover Crops on Upper Midwest Farms, 2025 Data Report

note: Informational survey benchmark only. Never automatically substituted for farm cover cost; operator labor and ownership costs can differ. Enter incremental seed, seeding and termination costs; count only costs beyond the normal cash-crop program.
